name: Retain the earned Weak Potion of Light and frame nearby Canosel stone

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self = require('openmw.self')
local core = require('openmw.core')
local Actor = require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera = require('openmw.camera')
local nearby = require('openmw.nearby')
local util = require('openmw.util')

local elapsed = 0
return {{
    engineHandlers = {{
        onFrame = function(dt)
            elapsed = elapsed + dt
            if elapsed < 0.2 then return end
            elapsed = 0
            local rayEnd = camera.getViewTransform():inverse():apply(util.vector3(0, 0, -2000))
            local ray = nearby.castRay(camera.getPosition(), rayEnd, {{ignore = self}})
            if ray.hit then
                local feet = (ray.hitPos - self.position):length() / 22
                local eye = (ray.hitPos - camera.getPosition()):length() / 22
                print('PotionLight view distance: feet=' .. tostring(feet) .. ' eye=' .. tostring(eye))
            end
            assert(not Actor.isDead(self), 'Player died during original potion inventory survey')
            print('VilverinContinue potion stock='
                .. Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm', 0x9847f))
                .. ' health=' .. Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
                .. ' magicka=' .. Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
                .. ' fatigue=' .. Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self).current
                .. ' position=' .. tostring(self.position)
                .. ' pitch=' .. camera.getPitch()
                .. ' paused=' .. tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
        end,
    }},
}}
